summary: John's 5th-great-grandfather; farmer at Lickfinn, Gortnahoe parish, Co. Tipperary.
bio: Thomas Boney was a farmer at Lickfin, Gortnahoe, flourishing 1814, when his daughter Catherine was baptized (sponsor John Boney, Dwyer fn. 411). FamilySearch gives him a birth 'c1785', derived only from the 1904 register line (speculative). Whether Anastasia 'Anty' Boney (c.1812-1896) was also his daughter is unproven. Possible later Boney kin in Plymouth: Jeremiah Boney, 30, in Anastasia's 1860 household, and James Boney, 22, miner, in an 1870 Plymouth Heffernan household (speculative).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
openQuestions: Anastasia Boney's baptism (c.1806-13) to test whether she was his daughter.
